salient_findings: Diffuse extraoral swelling over the right cheek
Solitary, mobile, submucosal mass on the right buccal mucosa
key_facts: 30-year-old woman
2-month history of swelling in the right cheek
Severe pain associated with the swelling
Diffuse extraoral swelling over the right cheek
Solitary, mobile, 2 cm × 2 cm submucosal mass on the right buccal mucosa
Ill-defined borders of the submucosal mass
Smooth mucosal surface of the submucosal mass
No colour change of the mucosal surface
Ultrasonography showed a well-defined, hypoechoic lesion in the right cheek region

shortlist.label: Lipoma
shortlist.why_kept: Matches the clinical description of a mobile, submucosal mass with a smooth surface

shortlist.label: Ectopic lymph node
shortlist.why_kept: Considered in the provisional diagnosis and consistent with the ultrasonography findings

shortlist.label: Mucocele
shortlist.why_kept: Possible cause of a swelling in the cheek with a smooth mucosal surface

shortlist.label: Keratocystic odontogenic tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Could present as a submucosal mass in the cheek region

shortlist.label: Salivary gland tumor
shortlist.why_kept: A possible cause of a swelling in the cheek, given the location and description of the mass

raw.rationale: The presence of a solitary, mobile, submucosal mass with a smooth mucosal surface and ill-defined borders, along with ultrasonography showing a well-defined, hypoechoic lesion, is consistent with a lipoma. The lack of color change and the mobile nature of the mass also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Ectopic lymph node
rejected.why: Ectopic lymph nodes are typically not mobile and may have a more irregular surface

rejected.label: Mucocele
rejected.why: Mucoceles usually present with a fluctuant, bluish lesion due to the accumulation of mucin, which is not described in this case

rejected.label: Keratocystic odontogenic tumor
rejected.why: These tumors are typically associated with the jaw and have a more aggressive behavior, which does not match the clinical presentation

rejected.label: Salivary gland tumor
rejected.why: Salivary gland tumors can have a varied presentation, but the description of a mobile, submucosal mass with a smooth surface is more suggestive of a lipoma
